newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume collapses.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume collapses.

text.p: The overall downward trend in world gold prices was reflected in the Istanbul gold exchange on Monday as dollar prices fell, volume collapsed and lira prices crept up slightly due to the weakness of the Turkish currency.

Gold closed at $371.50 an ounce versus $372.50 on Friday and volume plunged to 125 kilos from 1,760 kilos. Prices edged up in lira terms to 1,224,400 per gram, from previous 1,224,000 as the lira eased against the dollar.
The lira closed at 102,480 to the dollar after Friday's 101,800.
Dealers said the market was dominated by bearish sentiment with traders waiting for the world prices to bottom out amid uncertainty.
There was only 20 kilos of trade in the morning session, followed by 105 kilos in the afternoon. 68 percent of the total trade was in dollar terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
